checklist.notes: The language and task demands in the A1-U01-L01 EXERCISE_SET are broadly appropriate for its declared CEFR tier.
Answer explanations include the ungrammatical formulations “We takes read; Minh takes reads” and “A third-person singular subject takes walks.”
The reviewed A1-U01-L01 EXERCISE_SET remains within its declared lesson references and communicative scope.
The answers or static protocol in the A1-U01-L01 EXERCISE_SET are internally coherent and usable as written.
The exercise items are mostly clear, but these malformed metalinguistic explanations are not acceptable learner-facing English.

No suspiciously distinctive copied passage is apparent in the short A1-U01-L01 EXERCISE_SET, but internal inspection cannot establish originality beyond the retained project evidence and no Internet-wide comparison was performed.

findings.description: Two answer explanations use ungrammatical “takes + inflected verb” wording and may confuse learners about agreement.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite directly, for example: “Use read after we and reads after Minh” and “A third-person singular subject takes the form walks.”

limitations: This review covers only the immutable A1-U01-L01 EXERCISE_SET and its fresh static machine-report context. It does not assess human or release approval, provider authentication, live-provider behavior, learner outcomes, or Internet-wide originality.
